content: User caught a real architecture gap: run.*.asset.md contracts for plan/make/check/reflect-and-seed (and orchestrate) were prose-only, executed by an agent hand-writing JSONL via write_file, while only pmcro-trail:initialize had an actual deterministic script (New-Trail.ps1). Give every phase its own zero-reasoning script, matching that precedent, so file mechanics stop being reasoned about by hand each cycle.
